description: Partial demolition of single storey rear wing and addition of 1st and 2nd storey extension, alterations to provide two x one bed, two x two bed and one x three bed maisonettes and erection of four 2-storey houses to the rear
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the herby permitted extensions to the public house and the erection of the houses have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority (including samples of the stock brick, rendered finish with incised lines and cast/wrought iron filigree canopy). Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposal contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and numbered 470/P/001, 470/P/002, 470/P/003, 470/P/004, Received 5 December 2011, 470/P/013, 470/P/014, 470/P/015, 470/P/016, 470/P/017, 470/P/018, Received 5 December 2011, 470/P/005A, Received 3 February 2012, 470/P/006A, 470/P/007A, 470/P/010A, , Received 27 February 2012, 470/P/019, Received 22 March 2012, 470/P/012B, 470/P/009C, 470/P/008D, 470/P/011D, Received 27 March 2012   and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the first floor northern elevation of the terrace of houses shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscure glazing.
Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the western elevation of the extension above the billiard hall shall be obscure glazed and non-opening unless the opening is 1.7m above finished floor level.

Condition : 6 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the houses or erection of any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of each house shall be carried out.

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no additional windows/dormer windows shall be constructed on the houses.
Condition : 8 - The waste and recycled materials storage arrangements shown on the approved drawings shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 9 - Development shall not commence until a scheme for control of fumes and odours and the ventilation of the premises including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.

Condition : 10 - The rating level of any noise generated by plant & equipment as part of the development shall be at least 10 dB below the pre-existing background level as determined by BS4142: 1997-"Method of rating industrial noise affecting mixed residential and industrial areas".

Condition : 11 - The parking, loading, turning and cycle parking spaces shown on drawing 470/P/006A shall be constructed and available for use before first occupation of any part of
the development and such spaces shall not be used for any other purposes.

Condition : 12 - No development shall take place until the applicant has secured the implementation of a programme of Archaeological work, in accordance with a written scheme of
Investigation which has been submitted by the applicant and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 13 - A landscape management plan, including long term design objectives, management responsibilities and maintenance schedules for the communal amenity area shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority prior to the occupation of the development. The landscape management plan shall be carried out as approved for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 14 - Within three months of the first occupation of the residential flats the land shown on the site plan 470/P/006A as communal amenity area and soft landscaping shall be laid out in accordance with that plan as amenity area.

Condition : 15 - The flat roof areas of the extensions hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 16 - Separate access to the residential accommodation on the upper floors of the premises shall be available to residents at all times.

Condition : 17 - Prior to the commencement of development a scheme for insulating the public house, residential flats and residential dwellings against noise emissions shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall address internal and external noise and the transmission of airborne and impact sounds and shall consider both the residential flats and dwellings. Consideration shall be given to the public house, including live and recorded music, sound limiting devices, functions and operating hours, and may require additional conditions regarding the operation of the public house. 

Any works which form part of the scheme shall be completed before any part of the development is first occupied, and shall be maintained thereafter.

Condition : 18 - The access doorway to the public house on the front eastern corner shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.

Condition : 19 - Activities relating to the collection of refuse and recyclables and the tipping of empty bottles into external receptacles shall only take place between 07.00 and 23.00 Monday to Saturday and 09.00 and 20.00 on Sundays and Bank Holidays.
Condition : 20 - The outdoor terrace at the rear of the billiard hall shall not be used between 22.00 hours and 08.00 hours on any day and there shall be no live or recorded music played.
